statement: For each fixed real alpha in the probability model of source.md as precisely interpreted in problem.md, Y_d converges to 0 almost surely if and only if alpha > 1/2. More precisely, for every epsilon > 0, the series sum_d P(|Y_d| > epsilon) diverges when alpha < 1/2, converges when alpha > 1/2, and at alpha = 1/2 converges exactly when epsilon > 2; cross-dimensional independence therefore excludes the endpoint almost surely.
contribution: A complete, self-contained classification of the frozen logarithmically damped critical Pearson walk, including the sharp probability-series behavior at alpha = 1/2. This submission makes no novelty or priority claim.
